review.identity: Reviewed against the explicitly adopted canonical neutral: pale-yellow bear or pink rabbit, original large brown oval eyes, muzzle, red beret and asymmetric rabbit ears retained. The new teacup is an intentional eye-catch prop.
review.style: Original warm-brown contour and watercolor fill retained. Light and dark alpha composites inspected, without alpha cleanup, contour filtering or source rescaling.
review.alpha: Both original RGBA sheets and all18 exact cell crops pass alpha8 nonempty margins>=2px. No clipped ears, feet, cups or empty poses. Non-divisible source dimensions use rounded fractional 3x3 boundaries.
review.motion: Four stock actions inspected. Cup hold/raise/sip/lower positions distinct; tea_sip upper rim meets the lower mouth contour. Bow is a modest angled forward bend with two degrees, not a 90-degree bow. Jump crouch/takeoff/air/land retain actual drawn lift; dance left/right lean in opposite directions and step has one planted foot. GIFs show discrete key poses; timing and dense interpolation remain scene work.

calibration.method: Measured neutral standing-height proxy plus sheet-to-sheet head-width transfer; one isotropic scale per sheet.
calibration.notes: The tea-sheet neutral top-to-foot proxy includes its existing ears/beret. Jump-sheet scale is transferred by the manually reviewed cheek/head span; ear tips and beret are excluded from that width. No per-pose fit or inferred head pivot.

review.identity: Canonical neutral supplied directly to every generation; original species-specific face, eye form, palette, markings and watercolor contour retained. Tiger stripes, Siamese blue eyes/brown points, hedgehog spines all visually compared.
review.style: Full-resolution light/dark composites inspected. Original watercolor texture stays inside silhouettes; no outside paper field or visible haze. No pixel repainting, alpha cleaning or contour repair.
review.alpha: All18 original RGBA cells nonempty, alpha maximum255, full alpha8 silhouettes have >=2px clearance on every cell edge. Raw low-alpha RGB/edge noise preserved and inspected through correct compositing.
review.motion: Four eye-catches have explicit tea lift/sip/lower, polite half/deep bow/return, jump preparation/takeoff/air/landing and opposing dance/step/finish keys. Cup rim meets mouth in sip key and tea is amber. Bow range is a deliberately gentle stylized inclination. Jump feet are visibly airborne and use inferred ground support. Discrete key poses require scene timing/interpolation review.

calibration.method: Measured first-sheet neutral standing proxy and neutral-head-envelope width transfer across sheets; fixed per-sheet isotropic scale.
calibration.notes: All nine cells of each sheet share this one reference height. No per-pose bounding-box fitting or rescaling. Numeric spans are art-registration proxies, not measured skeleton pivots. Bowed/crouched/airborne silhouettes keep their drawn differences.

calibration.method: Neutral-standing natural-height proxy plus reviewed mid-face-width transfer between source sheets.
calibration.notes: One isotropic scale shared by all9 keys in this sheet; no per-pose fitting. Tea neutral reference includes full original ear-to-foot footprint. Jump sheet is transferred by the numeric mid-face span of its neutral standing key to preserve face size. This is a scale proxy, not a measured head pivot or certified final episode choreography.

numeric_evidence.scope: Reviewed mid-face silhouette band; ear tips, cup and tail excluded.

review.identity: Own adopted canonical reference used for both sheets; original watercolor texture, brown contour, oval eye construction, muzzle, species colors/markings and full tail retained.
review.style: All18 new raster keys inspected on correctly composited light and dark backgrounds. Texture is within silhouettes, no background/haze or floating symbols. Exact source RGBA pixels retained.
review.alpha: All18 cells have nonempty alpha8 visible bounds and at least2px clear margins on every side, with original alpha untouched.
review.motion: Tea hold/raise/sip/lower show actual cup-mouth contact and return. Bow stages are a gentle polite bend, without claiming measured geometric angles. Jump crouch/takeoff/air/land is distinct, both airborne baselines inferred and recorded. Dance uses opposite gentle leans and a one-foot step. These are discrete key-pose stocks; smooth interpolation and final timing remain scene work.

review.identity: Canonical neutral supplied directly to every generation; original species-specific face, eye form, palette, markings and watercolor contour retained. Tiger stripes, Siamese blue eyes/brown points, hedgehog spines all visually compared.
review.style: Full-resolution light/dark composites inspected. Original watercolor texture stays inside silhouettes; no outside paper field or visible haze. No pixel repainting, alpha cleaning or contour repair.
review.alpha: All18 original RGBA cells nonempty, alpha maximum255, full alpha8 silhouettes have >=2px clearance on every cell edge. Raw low-alpha RGB/edge noise preserved and inspected through correct compositing.
review.motion: Four eye-catches have explicit tea lift/sip/lower, polite half/deep bow/return, jump preparation/takeoff/air/landing and opposing dance/step/finish keys. Cup rim meets mouth in sip key and tea is amber. Bow range is a deliberately gentle stylized inclination. Jump feet are visibly airborne and use inferred ground support. Discrete key poses require scene timing/interpolation review.

calibration.method: Measured first-sheet neutral standing proxy and neutral-head-envelope width transfer across sheets; fixed per-sheet isotropic scale.
calibration.notes: All nine cells of each sheet share this one reference height. No per-pose bounding-box fitting or rescaling. Numeric spans are art-registration proxies, not measured skeleton pivots. Bowed/crouched/airborne silhouettes keep their drawn differences.
